name: kintopp-plugins
description: Kintopp Plugins: MCP connectors and research skills for cultural heritage data

plugins.name: skkg
plugins.description: Search the collection of the Stiftung für Kunst, Kultur und Geschichte (SKKG, Winterthur): about 64,000 objects with German metadata, provenance, acquisitions, literature, exhibitions and images.

plugins.name: rijksmuseum-iconclass
plugins.description: Search and browse the Iconclass art-subject classification: about 1.3 million notations in 13 languages, with keyword and semantic search and Rijksmuseum artwork counts, plus a research guidance skill.
